title: Monday evening: the designs done, the app on the web, and six decisions waiting for Dinis
when: Monday 9 November 2026, 16:40 UTC (for the 18:00 London stand-up; the summit opens tomorrow)
headline: Since the 12:00 brief: 44 releases (v0.1.824 to v0.1.868). Every page in the approved-designs brief passes: designer@ for the list pages, the day pages and /events/, and sherpa@ for the reader. Only the past days wait for the summit. The news app now runs on the web at /app/: the programme, picks, clashes, calendar files; it installs to the home screen and works offline, and nothing personal leaves the browser. The iOS calendar's busy/free fix is in the data (shows_as on every event, agreeing with the apps' shared rules). The conductors now take turns, one awake every 12 minutes, and mine moved to :36. Six decisions relayed as Dinis's words wait for his own confirmation here.
